Business work such as checking stock and validating state transitions is handed to application use cases injected through the constructor (PlaceOrderUseCase, TransitionOrderUseCase, CancelOrderUseCase, ListOrdersUseCase).
parsedVerdict.reasoning: OrderController is an Express HTTP adapter, and that fits the infrastructure layer. Each method takes the input from the request (req.params, req.body) and calls an application use case. It then writes the result as an HTTP status and JSON body. handleError only turns error names into HTTP status codes (400, 404 or 500), which is transport work. Business rules such as stock checks or allowed state transitions stay in the use cases and the domain. The casts to OrderState are type annotations only and add no logic. Nothing in the file does persistence or carries domain rules that belong in another layer.
